title: Anything else to add
summary: Hawkins cannot think of more and a tape change follows.

blocks.x: Are there other things that you can think of that were significant in your career? Or, your life, that you would like to share? That we haven't touched on or that you would like to amplify?

I was just wondering, thinking. I had such an enjoyable career. It's hard for me to get my thoughts together now that I would like for you to know. But, I had such a fine time with everybody we've talked about. But, I don't know just where else to put my finger on right now. Sometimes, I forget my sister's name, some times. No, I shouldn't. Not exactly. You know.
I know what you mean. Sure.
